auditNotes.platformFingerprints: WooCommerce + Woodmart theme + WP Rocket + Yoast SEO; Server: Apache
auditNotes.originRuleSelectiveFilter: SQLi/XSS query-string payloads return 403 with HTML body (not Wordfence runtime); blocks attack patterns only. Crawler does not send these, so hasWaf=false operationally.
auditNotes.perPageCap: ?per_page=250 honored on /product-category/<slug>/page/2/; per_page=1000 silently falls back to default 12 (server cap somewhere between 500 and 1000). Shipping 100 (verified clean, low latency).
auditNotes.parentCategoryQuirk: Woodmart theme: parent category page 1 (e.g. /product-category/ammunition/) shows subcategory tiles via .wd-with-subcat - page 2+ paginate real products. Crawler must walk past page 1.

stageNotes: Stage 1: apex 200, www 301->apex, <link rel=canonical> = apex. canonicalOrigin = https://budgetshootersupply.ca

Stage 2: heavy 8-batch probe. No CDN WAF (no cf-ray/x-sucuri/incap). SQLi/XSS 403s - origin rule-selective, not blocking catalog. hasWaf=false operational; hasCaptcha=false (no reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile markers).
Stage 3: WooCommerce + Woodmart theme + WP Rocket 3.20.2 + Yoast SEO 27.4. age_verify=no in woodmart_settings JS. needsPlaywright=false (Store API + HTML category pages work via plain HTTP).

Stage 4: 24 top-level categories from /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat; 2 food categories excluded (freeze-dried-food, self-heating-food); 22 catalogUrls kept (incl. 5 empty/count=0 that returned 200). Parent-category tile-page quirk noted.
Stage 5: pagination type=path /page/{N}/. perPage=12 default, verified up to 250 (page-2 on RPC category with ?per_page=250 returned 250 distinct products). Shipping perPage=100.
Stage 6: <select name="orderby"> options: menu_order/popularity/rating/date/price/price-desc. 3-outcome test with cache-bust: default(menu_order) != ?orderby=date != ?orderby=price -> sort honored.
Stage 7: WC two-probe - /wp-json/wp/v2/product?after=2099 -> x-wp-total:0; ?after=1999 -> x-wp-total:2808. api-date-since-watermark.
Stage 8: Store-API header x-wp-total:1586 (customer-visible). WP REST /wp/v2/product header would give ~2808 (includes drafts).
Stage 9: validator not run (no programmatic invocation in this blind run); JSON written, calibration-diff to follow.
